monline.name: Melville's Marginalia Online
monline.citation: Melville's Marginalia Online. Steven Olsen-Smith and Peter Norberg, eds. https://melvillesmarginalia.org. Accessed 2026-08-27.
monline.terms: Policies page: written/edited material may be quoted or cited with author + title + 'Melville's Marginalia Online' + the two main editors + date of access. The stated restriction is on PHOTOGRAPHIC IMAGES (one-time display permission from holding institutions), not on the transcriptions. Read 2026-08-27.

aor.name: The Archaeology of Reading in Early Modern Europe
aor.citation: The Archaeology of Reading in Early Modern Europe. Sheridan Libraries (JHU), CELL (UCL), CDH (Princeton); Mellon-funded https://archaeologyofreading.org. Accessed 2026-08-27.
aor.terms: GitHub repo livesandletters/aor carries NO licence file and the site publishes no reuse statement found as of 2026-08-27. Counts and metadata only until someone asks them. Contact CELL before any bulk republication of the note transcriptions or translations.

whitman.name: The Walt Whitman Archive — Annotations and Marginalia
whitman.citation: The Walt Whitman Archive — Annotations and Marginalia. Kenneth M. Price and Ed Folsom, dirs.; Matt Cohen, marginalia project https://whitmanarchive.org/manuscripts/marginalia. Accessed 2026-08-27.
whitman.terms: Data repo whitmanarchive/whitman-marginalia carries no licence file. The Archive's public terms are CC BY-NC-ND on site content; the TEI repos state no licence. Counts and metadata only pending a check. Read 2026-08-27.

derrida.name: Derrida's Margins
derrida.citation: Derrida's Margins. Katie Chenoweth, Rebecca Sutton Koeser, Renee Altergott, Alexander Baron-Raiffe, Jean Bauer, Chad Cordova, Austin Hancock, Benjamin Hicks, Nick Budak, Kevin McElwee, Chloe Vettier; Center for Digital Humanities, Princeton https://derridas-margins.princeton.edu. Accessed 2026-08-27.
derrida.terms: Derrida's Margins Datasets v1.1.1, doi:10.34770/2ezk-1104, distributed by Princeton Data Commons. Rights field reads exactly: 'CC BY -- Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International'. The only openly licensed source in the corpus, and therefore the only one whose note text ships in full. An earlier v1 on Figshare is CC0 but is SUPERSEDED -- use the DOI. Read 2026-08-27.

nietzsche.name: Friedrich Nietzsche, works (Project Gutenberg German texts)
nietzsche.citation: Friedrich Nietzsche, works (Project Gutenberg German texts). Public domain; Nietzsche died 1900 https://www.gutenberg.org. Accessed 2026-08-27.
nietzsche.terms: The underlying texts are public domain worldwide. Project Gutenberg's own licence attaches to their MARKED-UP FILES and to use of the trademark, not to the public-domain work, so the header and licence block are stripped and the text itself is emitted. Same treatment literature-mutations already applies to its 345 Gutenberg texts. NOTE this is NOT the Colli-Montinari critical text (eKGWB) -- that is de Gruyter copyright, published online by permission, and must never be redistributed from here. Read 2026-08-27.

shakeco.name: The Shakespeare and Company Project
shakeco.citation: The Shakespeare and Company Project. Joshua Kotin, dir.; Center for Digital Humanities, Princeton. Dataset v1.2 (2022-01), doi:10.34770 series https://shakespeareandco.princeton.edu. Accessed 2026-08-27.
shakeco.terms: Princeton Data Commons rights field reads 'CC BY -- Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International' on all fourteen deposited datasets (members, books, events, and the combined package, v1 / v1.1 / v1.2). Data derives from Sylvia Beach's own lending cards and logbooks; the card IMAGES are Princeton University Library's, served from IIIF, and are linked rather than copied. Read 2026-08-27.

abo.name: Annotated Books Online
abo.citation: Annotated Books Online. Arnoud Visser and Paul Dijstelberge, eds.; Utrecht University / University of Amsterdam, 'A Collaboratory for the Study of Reading and the Circulation of Ideas' https://annotatedbooksonline.com. Accessed 2026-08-27.
abo.terms: conditions-of-use page reads: 'You are free to use the images of digitized books on ABO for non-commercial purposes, but we ask that you give credit to the copyright holders who retain rights to the images. These works are licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-Noncommercial license.' Transcriptions therefore ship with attribution; the NC clause constrains COMMERCIAL reuse downstream, which any consumer of _data/ must respect -- it is the one source here whose licence is narrower than CC BY. Images are linked, never copied. Read 2026-08-27.

beckett.name: The Beckett Digital Library (Beckett Digital Manuscript Project)
beckett.citation: The Beckett Digital Library (Beckett Digital Manuscript Project). Dirk Van Hulle, Mark Nixon and Vincent Neyt, eds.; University of Antwerp https://www.beckettarchive.org/library/home/welcome. Accessed 2026-08-27.
beckett.terms: Module (c) 2017 Samuel Beckett Digital Manuscript Project. The BDMP sells a subscription; what it gates is the FACSIMILE IMAGES -- the bibliography, reading-trace page lists, student-library reading dates and marginalia TRANSCRIPTIONS are served publicly. But Beckett died in 1989, so his marginalia are unpublished work in copyright until roughly 2059 and controlled by his Estate. This is therefore the STRICTEST source in the corpus: emit_text False, no text at all, not even the marked passage. The reason differs from AOR and Whitman -- there the licence is merely unstated; here the underlying work is in copyright. Read 2026-08-27.
